push-version: V=$(php -r "\$v=json_decode(file_get_contents('composer.json'))->version;while(trim(shell_exec('git tag -l v'.\$v))){\$p=explode('.',\$v);\$p[2]++;\$v=implode('.',\$p);}\$j=file_get_contents('composer.json');\$j=preg_replace('/\"version\": \"[^\"]*\"/', '\"version\": \"'.\$v.'\"', \$j);file_put_contents('composer.json',\$j);echo \$v;") && git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Release v$V") && git tag -a "v$V" -m "Release v$V" && git push origin "v$V"
